SELECT 'period' k, fiscal_period_label a, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(weeks_in_period AS VARCHAR) d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'format', format, CAST(count(DISTINCT store_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM dim_store GROUP BY format

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cs.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT format, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl,
       sum(net_amount) sold_net, sum(quantity) qty, min(net_amount) minnet, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount<=0) nonpos
FROM sold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
r AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM fact_return_line r JOIN sold USING (sales_line_id)
)
SELECT count(*) n_ret, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d_ret, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_sold_lines,
  sum(refund_net) refund_net, min(return_date) mind, max(return_date) maxd,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN sold s2 USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.quantity_returned > s2.quantity) qty_over,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM r GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) multi_ret_lines,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id FROM r JOIN sold s3 USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY r.sales_line_id, s3.quantity, s3.net_amount HAVING sum(quantity_returned) > s3.quantity OR sum(refund_net) > s3.net_amount + 0.01)) over_refund,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE refund_net<=0) nonpos,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE return_date < (SELECT sale_date FROM sold WHERE sold.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) before_sale,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) orphans_all
FROM r

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web_store, f.channel_code, o.status, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(r.return_line_id) n_ret, sum(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cs.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(l.net_amount) sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) returned_net,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)) AS stores_with_format_change
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY l.format
